summary:
IMPORTANT NEW USER CLARIFICATION: Do not merely apply a checklist or return recommendations. Research and investigate the remaining rubric gaps yourself, determine the strongest defensible solutions, and implement all PRESENTATION-ONLY improvements you can substantiate. Audit every one of the20 rubric criteria and work toward the strongest supported pitch, excluding demo and Q&A. The user says to 'do research and things and figure it all out and solve all the issues that would make it so that we do not get100', but this is an objective, not permission to fabricate evidence or promise a judge score.

Research primary sources for current competitor capabilities, AI-code security, the precise user segment, market/payer sizing, pricing comparables and the feasibility/capacity assumptions behind the approved growth scenario. Check source dates, definitions, denominators and population fit. Inspect available repository docs/tests/artifacts and the user-supplied costs and feedback before asking for anything again. Use credible outside research to support need and planning choices, NOT to impersonate Ari interviews, acquired customers, measured product results or paid commitments. Keep42newpaid/month and its honest source/derived-target caveat as explicitly approved by the human. If research cannot establish a claimed advantage, narrow/reframe it accurately rather than invent proof. Distinguish reported/observed, tested, simulated, planned and hypothesized throughout.

Make presentation edits, relevant notes/source references, graphics/animations, script and presentation tests ONLY. No application/product feature changes, real assessments or attack testing, customer messages, purchases, subscriptions, website billing/plan changes, hiring, or invented traction. You may inspect existing supplied results read-only. Build the strongest truthful story and measurable pilot/economic/roadmap plan from what exists. Resolve research, math, presentation consistency and wording issues autonomously. Consolidate only genuinely irreducible human-evidence/eligibility gaps in a short final checklist without filling them falsely or blocking all safe edits. No guarantee of100/100. Keep the timed deck readable and concise instead of adding piles of text. Complete implementation and validation, not just a proposed plan.

TO ALAN AI / ai-4: The human user in Sai's chat explicitly asks you to implement ALL remaining presentation-side improvements from the rubric review, excluding the demo and Q&A, and asked me to send this consolidated handoff. This expands your prior slide10-only scope. Your map commit9059c3b is acknowledged; preserve it. I am not editing the deck in parallel.

GOAL AND CONSTRAINTS
Improve evidence, clarity, consistency and measurable plans; do not promise100/100. Work in https://github.com/SaiC123/ari-ai-presentation, public/index.html. Read AGENTS.md and coordination/README.md, setup/status, pull clean latest main, acquire your lock with an expanded BEFORE. Plan only if locked. Preserve the new nine-competitor map, October17 original feedback screenshots/highlight, Ari palette/font/ant, forward/backward/reduced-motion behavior and current18-slide order wherever possible. Keep the deck graphic-first with short labels; use notes/appendix/source docs for detail. No em dashes. Do not redesign the demo or invent Q&A.

NONNEGOTIABLE FINANCIALS FROM USER
Keep Founder49.99/7 assessments, Growth129.99/20, Scale359.99/60, current assessed-line pools and team-supplied cost breakdown. Keep42newpaid/month scenario and the citation DIRECTLY BELOW the figure. ChartMogul2025 median B2B time to1000subscribers is24months;42=round1000/24) is a DERIVED planning target, NOT an observed monthly acquisition average or guarantee. Source https://chartmogul.com/reports/saas-go-to-market-report/ . User has already supplied the cost model; do not ask them to resend it or replace their numbers merely to hit a desired score. Retain18.2percent initial opt-in trial conversion PROXY,2percent assumed paid churn, conditional M2monthly coverage/M3cumulative recovery,32Founderaccountthreshold. Do not call these full-business profitability; founder pay/paid acquisition/extras excluded.

SLIDE-BY-SLIDE CHANGES
1-4: Keep hypothetical-founder label visible once, all founder figures illustrative. Separate the Veracode45percent tested-code result from Check Point attack-attempt trend; avoid equals/causal visual implication that research establishes AI coding caused the rise. Keep primary citations and sample-scope caveats. Do not turn raised funding into automatic personal debt; if personal liability appears, label it an illustrative liability scenario rather than a universal founder consequence.

5-6: Sharpen the existing ICP visually: founder-led small SaaS, AI-assisted coding, no dedicated security team. Distinguish user hypothesis from customer-validated facts. Add a minimal barriers/priorities strip (limited review time, security expertise, understandable evidence, code privacy) labeled hypotheses unless supported by supplied feedback. Add a speaker-note evidence slot for exact participant roles/counts, workflow observations and buying priorities. Do not invent interview findings.

8-9: Make Ari's contribution an explicit proposed user-value chain: shared version-aware business intent -> bounded attack evidence -> human-approved repair -> independent verification -> saved regression evidence. Explain WHY approval and separate verification matter, not just seven agent names. Add a concise 'Built by us' or technical-contribution note ONLY after team confirms which orchestration/context/verification components were created during HackATL; no false originality or exclusivity claims. Preserve RL simulation-only and scripted/full-chain disclosures. Avoid complexity as proof of value.

10: Preserve/enhance your completed nine-competitor map. Named competitors and their sourced capabilities, overlapping scope, costs/human-approval tradeoffs. Distinguish PROPOSED differentiation from benchmark-proven advantage. Create an evidence-ready comparison reference (same authorized repo/scenario, version/date, scope, what each tool tested, finding usefulness, reproducibility, verified repair, cost/time, failures). Populate only real observations. Do not manufacture benchmark wins or assign unsupported superiority coordinates. No extra competing map rewrite needed if9059c3b already covers it.

11: Keep workflow/accessibility/verification outputs and honest limitations. Separate actual implemented product accessibility from presentation keyboard/reduced-motion features; no WCAG certification or observed usability claims without evidence. Do not equate deck/financial-model tests with product security tests. Add notes for observed task completion/permission comprehension only if supplied. Do not alter or script the live demo requested to be excluded from this task.

12: Preserve latest five original email screenshots and accurate provenance. Keep Jordan's exact reported repair/test outcome. No invented time saved, measured prevention, participant counts beyond documented five emails or paying-customer inference. Remove the empty VC-validation panel from the timed pitch until genuine feedback exists; keep a pending note instead. Surface Samira's permission/code-processing request as a concrete NEXT IMPROVEMENT, not a completed product change unless verified. Optional small before/after evidence graphic: reported weakness -> reviewed repair -> attack test blocked + existing tests passed, retaining 'reported' label. Put impact-measurement slots in notes, not giant public placeholders. A customer-metric card needs verified time/accepted fixes/task result/sample size before being labeled measured.

13: Keep supplied unit costs and current42scenario. Label input provenance cleanly: team-provided API/run, planned infra/AWS/support allowances, fee assumptions; retain per-run cost logging/positive-observed-contribution expansion gate. Add reference sensitivity cases at full plan allowance, larger repo/retries and founder support time, without fabricating measured usage. Prefer appendix/source notes, not crowding the live graph. Show pricing is introductory pilot pricing, future prices subject to actual delivery/customer-value validation. Do not change live payment systems or website pricing. Clarify shared500tools vs customer delivery costs, contribution vs full profit, monthly coverage vs cumulative recovery. Use existing docs/pilot-cost-measurement.csv rather than asking user to resend their breakdown.

14: Keep Census counts/annual pricing math transparent. Software publishers are a PROXY, not verified AI-SaaS-with-no-security-team counts. Show initial buyer definition and payer clearly. Additional AI adoption/security staffing filters can only be added from matched data with explicit assumptions; do not multiply incompatible survey populations or invent a qualified-account count. Add source/scope notes and a qualified-account-validation plan where evidence is absent.

15: Make the route to pilots and growth operational, not only arrows. Keep initial100targets/30calls/10partners/5pilots/3TOTALpaid explicitly proposed. Distinguish this first recruitment milestone from the later42/month growth scenario; never imply3/5measuredconversion. Explain founder outreach/accelerator channels, named owner roles and weekly contact/call/paid tracking. Build a measurable proposed pilot scorecard: five authorized scoped pilots; each records one assessment outcome, repair acceptance/rejection, verification evidence, actual delivery cost/support time and a willingness-to-continue/pay decision. Expansion requires scope/permissions understood and positive observed contribution at promised allowance. Clearly label these PLANNED success gates, not results or signed commitments. If3paid is only a goal, say goal. Do not promise42growth without an acquisition channel/capacity path; any leads/conversion arithmetic must be labeled a capacity target, not a sourced average. Actual contacts/partner commitments require user input.

16: Keep roadmap timeline/resources/risks and animated ant clearance. Strengthen each gate with owner-role, measurable exit condition and fallback. Examples, labeled proposed: M1live-provider trace+five scoped pilot records; M2-3hosted beta+recorded paid decisions and measured contribution; M4-6multi-repo only after permissions isolation and reliability checks; enterprise after support/controls readiness and adequate funding. If gate fails, narrow scope, fix reliability or reprice before expansion. No unsupported hiring/certification/customer/ARR claims. Existing six founders/capped compute and500sharedtools plus delivery are resources, not an all-in launch budget.

17-18: Preserve supplied team names/photos/credentials without embellishment. End with ONE concrete milestone/ask, e.g. seeking five qualified SaaS design partners for authorized scoped pilots, only framed as a request/goal. Keep the six-part graphic recap and final Ari animation. Never imply five are already committed unless supplied.

DISCLOSURE, SCRIPT, EVIDENCE HYGIENE
Create a concise originality/disclosure reference identifying what was created during HackATL versus pre-existing tools/assets. Ask the team for the facts; do NOT assert kickoff eligibility or invent build history. The rubric says prebuilt team projects/previously submitted ventures are ineligible, and libraries/assets require disclosure. If facts are missing, mark pending in presenter notes/checklist and explain it is a material unresolved disclosure, not a completed fix.
Update the full script to match actual slide numbers/labels and remove obsolete 'only true end-to-end' and causal AI-attack wording. Speakers: Sarosh1-6; Srihith7-11; Vihaan prototype demo after11 (do not write the demo); Sai12-16; Sarosh17-18. Keep draft spoken non-demo script under700words; it is not a verified5minute rehearsal, and reserve actual demo/handoff time. Put bracketed evidence tasks in nonspoken notes, not fabricated spoken claims. No giant placeholders in final timed slides.

NEEDED HUMAN INPUT, DO NOT FABRICATE
Exact customer research/roles/counts and permission to use feedback; measured customer outcomes; actual product usability tests; comparator runs; observed delivery-cost distribution/support workload if available beyond supplied cost model; pricing responses or paid commitments; real pilot/partner confirmations and channel capacity; what was built during HackATL and pre-existing components. Consolidate these into ONE short evidence-needed checklist; implement safe presentation changes now without filling missing results.

ACCEPTANCE AND HANDOFF
Preserve unrelated source edits, no old-copy whole-file overwrite. Validate all builds/rewind/reduced motion, projector1280x720 layout/source readability/no overlap, financial calculations, evidence provenance, conditional wording and script/slide alignment. Inspect diff, run current Node/Python tests and add focused regressions. Commit/push latest main while holding lock. Deploy exact latest combined commit to EXISTING ari-ai-presentation if you have access; your previous account lacked it, so if still blocked say deployment pending and post exactSHA to ai-1 for user-authorized deployment, not a new project. AFTER must list actual checks, genuine missing evidence and deployment status, then release. Please acknowledge receipt and report completion in this shared repository channel.
